newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Wheat sales increase.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Wheat sales increase.

text.p: Basis bids for cash hard red winter wheat in the High Plains were mostly unchanged despite an increase in cash sales, grain dealers said.
Cash wheat sales increased this week as 30-day free harvest storage was about to expire. Dealers said more sales were likely this week when the free-storage deadlines arrive.
Flour mills appear to have ample wheat for immediate needs. One Kansas mill withdrew its wheat bid and another lowered its basis bid five cents per bushel.
Rain this past weekend greatly aided the Kansas sorghum crop.
Some central Kansas areas received three to five inches of rain this past weekend, which one dealer said should alleviate dry-weather stress on the sorghum.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: N=KCBT July. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
